action.message:
Implemented the fix in src/dotenv/main.py only. In set_key, quoted values now escape backslashes before apostrophes:

    value_out = "'{}'".format(
        value_to_set.replace("\\", "\\\\").replace("'", "\\'")
    )

This matches the parser's single-quote escape handling (`\\`, `\'`), so literal backslashes (including consecutive ones and those adjacent to apostrophes) round-trip through dotenv_values(interpolate=False). quote_mode='never' and the export prefix are unchanged, and no other files were touched.

tool_call.name: finish

summary: Fix backslash escaping in set_key quoted values
